7.description: [New Epic Enchant] Impeccable Timing - Your mastery of time magic gives you Impeccable Timing, increasing your chance to trigger Missile Barrage by 100%. You must bide your time for 10 seconds between Impeccable Timings. Requires the final rank of Missile Barrage.

[New Epic Enchant] Exhausting Leech - Your Shadow Bolt drains your target's life applying Lesser Curse of Exhaustion, slowing them by 35% for 5 seconds. This effect cannot occur more than once every 5 seconds, and requires the final rank of Soul Leech.

[New Epic Enchant] Blazing Barrier - Transforms your Combustion into Blazing Barrier, a shield placed on the caster, absorbing damage. If the shield is destroyed, a Blast Nova erupts, knocking back and slowing enemies for 2 sec. The cooldown is reduced by the Playing with Fire talent. Shares a cooldown with Ice Barrier.

[New Epic Enchant] Temporal Shield - Transforms your Pain Suppression into Temporal Shield. Envelops you in a temporal shield for 4 sec. All damage taken while shielded will be instantly restored if the shield lasts its full duration.
Demonic Influence now reduces the damage bonus from Metamorphosis by 10%, changed from 15%. (You still get 5% increased damage done while using Metamorphosis which is unchanged from previously.)

5.description: Reduced the bonus speed of the Shaman PvP boots to Ghost Wolf to 10%, changed from 15%.
Fixed an issue where Scrolls of Blinding Light would deal too much damage against player summoned Water Elemental and Treants.

0.description: [Alar] Resilient Constitution now reduces damage taken in PvP by 47%, changed from 45%.
Your heals and absorbs are now 5% less effective while using Spirit primary stat in 2v2 and 3v3 arena.
Fixed an issue where the Fungarian's Cloud of Rot PvP mod was not applying correctly. They now deal an additional 60% reduced damage in PvP.
[Requires Launcher Update] Added config options to hide or re-order resource bars in the movable energy / rage / mana bar.

[Alar] Introducing the [Dungeoneer Spoils of War]:

This Spoils of War has been hardcoded to help select gear upgrades for your current specialization and always will contain 1 piece of Heroic Dungeon gear and offers a chance at [BONUS GEAR] for tanks! This Spoils of war is available on four quest types currently.

- Adventurers Needed (Normal Daily Dungeon).
- A Lesser Known Issue.
- Adventurers Contract.
- Sanctioned Hunt.

These changes along with the Mythic Spoils of War from the Heroic Dungeon Daily quest should give heroes a clear path to character and gearing progression. Feedback on this lootbox is appreciated!

Adventurer's Needed [Heroic]: These quests will now reward Mythic Spoils of war from Normal Spoils of war. This change was made because it will help ease character progression when transitioning your hero into higher level content after hitting level 60.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where the window to choose between No-Risk and High-Risk would not appear at level 20. The window will still wait for you to finish combat before appearing.

[Requires Launcher Update] Overhauled the movable Rage / Energy display. It is now far more configurable, can be locked in place, and can optionally display a mana bar as well. You can access these new options by right clicking the movable Rage / Energy frame. (This also means your previous settings / positioning has been reset, sorry!)

Fixed an issue where Execute dummies could keep you in combat forever until relog.
Fixed an issue where Execute dummies could sometimes face players (making it really annoying for ambush/backstab players)
Fixed an issue where Crow\'s Cache would not announce who looted it.

5.description: Fixed an issue where the Gladiator's Tabard of Redemption visual wasn't displaying properly. The visual now appears, and it will learn to fly as intended on the next server restart.

[New Legendary Enchant] Forbidden Technique - Replaces your Shadow Dance with Forbidden Technique, firing a projectile dealing 130% Ranged Weapon damage as Shadow, teleporting you to the target and activating Shadow Dance. Your Shadow remains behind. While Shadow Dance is active, your Ambush costs 30 less energy and causes your Shadow to throw a Shadow Dagger at your target. 

When Shadow Dance ends you teleport back to your Shadow, absorbing some of its power. This gives you a chance to follow up your Ranged weapon attacks by throwing a Shadow Dagger at the target, dealing bonus damage and reducing the cooldown of your Forbidden Technique by 2 seconds.
